label: Здание
description: Twelve-mission case drill for здание (building) — all six cases, singular and plural.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative singular. The dictionary form здание stands as the subject after Это. Neuter nouns in -ие take a bare nominative, and for inanimate neuters this form also serves as the accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive singular. The nominative здание shifts to здания. The possessive у governs the genitive; -ие nouns take -ия in the genitive singular.
Strategic focus: Dative singular. Здание takes the dative ending зданию. The preposition к, marking movement toward a goal, governs the dative; -ие nouns take -ию here.
Strategic focus: Accusative singular. The direct object of строят is здание, identical to the nominative. For inanimate neuter nouns the accusative always matches the nominative.
Strategic focus: Instrumental singular. The nominative здание becomes зданием. The preposition перед, marking position in front, governs the instrumental; -ие nouns take -ием.

Strategic focus: Prepositional singular. Здание changes to здании after в. The -ие type is special: its prepositional singular ends in -ии (здании), not the regular -ье, and it never appears without a preposition.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. The plural subject is здания. Soft neuter -ие nouns form the nominative plural in -ия, here written здания.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural. The form зданий ends in -ий, the regular genitive plural for -ие nouns. The quantifier много governs the genitive.
Strategic focus: Dative plural. Здания becomes зданиям. The preposition к governs the dative; the dative plural ending -ям follows the soft -ие stem.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural. The direct object здания matches the nominative plural. Since здание is inanimate, the accusative plural equals the nominative plural.
Strategic focus: Instrumental plural. The plural здания takes the ending зданиями. The preposition между governs the instrumental; the soft stem takes -ями in the instrumental plural.
Strategic focus: Prepositional plural. Здания shifts to зданиях after в. The prepositional plural ending -ях follows the soft stem and always requires a preposition.
